Subject: Post-call recap: security discovery (IR / breach notification / BCP)

Hi Alex  great to meet today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of the call:
- FintechCorp is validating vendor IR and breach notification timelines as part of a Q4 audit.
- You asked about Redwood's incident response process, SLA for notification, and BCP/DR evidence that supports recovery objectives.
- You also wanted SOC 2 Type II evidence and clarification on GDPR/HIPAA applicability.

Actions we discussed (next steps):
1) Redwood to share SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and an IR playbook summary  target by EOD next week.
2) Provide a clear breach notification timeline and sample notification template.
3) Share BCP/DR executive summary that includes RTO/RPO and failover approach for Dedicated/private deployments.
4) Jordan and Marissa to coordinate any follow-up calls with your security team.

Please confirm this aligns with your expectations or add anything I missed. Happy to hop on a short follow-up with your security folks if helpful.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake

jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Thanks Jordan  this looks right. A couple of clarifying asks from our side so we can advance the procurement review: 

1) SOC 2: We need the most recent Type II report (redacted is fine). Can you include the date range and auditor?
2) Incident response / breach notification: in particular we need to confirm the maximum elapsed time between detection and customer notification for a confirmed data breach. What are your SLAs and who is on the escalation path?
3) BCP/DR: We need the RTO/RPO targets for your hosted and private deployments, plus a one-page summary we can include in our risk assessment.

Also starting a vendor questionnaire (attached)  please confirm who at Redwood will be the primary contact to complete the security questionnaire.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap / FintechCorp questionnaire

Thanks for the ping  I can take point on this. Draft responses and evidence below; attaching redacted copies where possible.

SOC 2:
- Attached: SOC2_Type2_Report_2025.pdf (redacted). Auditor: Clearwater LLP. Coverage period: 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31.

Incident response / breach notification:
- Detection -> Customer Notification: Our target notification time for confirmed security incidents involving customer data is 72 hours from confirmation of data exfiltration or compromise.
- We operate a tiered escalation model:
  - Tier 1 (Operational Detection): On-call SRE/SecOps performs Triage (0-2 hours)
  - Tier 2 (Confirmed Incident): Incident Response Lead engaged (within 4 hours)
  - Notification Decision & Legal/Privacy review: within 24-48 hours of confirmation
  - Customer notification: target within 72 hours of confirmation (unless restricted by law enforcement).
- On-call escalation: ir-oncall@redwood.ai and PagerDuty (Primary: secops-oncall). I can provide a named escalation contact if FintechCorp needs a human point-of-contact for contract language.

BCP / DR:
- Hosted API (Redwood public/hosted): RTO = 4 hours for API control-plane failover; RPO = 1 hour for user-visible state (depends on customer config).
- Redwood Dedicated / Private deployments: RTO = 8 hours for failover to alternate capacity; RPO = 1-4 hours depending on replication configuration.
- Attached: BCP_DR_Exec_Summary.pdf (one-pager with high-level runbook).

Questionnaire & evidence:
- I'll start filling the vendor questionnaire; suggest we return it within 5 business days.
- Attached also: IR_Playbook_Summary.pdf and Incident_Notification_Timeline.csv (sample timeline for a past incident, redacted).

Next steps (internal):
1) I will upload the SOC2 and the BCP/IR artifacts to the shared drive link and populate answers to the questionnaire.
2) Rachel, can you review any contract language around notification timeframes and confirm whether we should offer a named escalation contact?

If this looks good, Jordan will send the package to Alex and confirm expected completion date (EOD next Wednesday).

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

[Attachments: SOC2_Type2_Report_2025.pdf, IR_Playbook_Summary.pdf, BCP_DR_Exec_Summary.pdf, Incident_Notification_Timeline.csv]

Marissa / Jordan  quick review from contracts/compliance:
- 72-hour customer notification target is fine as a descriptive expectation; for contract language we should avoid absolute guarantees (force majeure / law enforcement exceptions).
- We can provide a named escalation contact in the SOW/Support Annex for Enterprise customers (name + role + escalation email/PD escalation policy).
- Suggested line for procurement: "Redwood aims to notify customers within 72 hours of confirmation of a data breach involving customer data, subject to legal restrictions and ongoing law enforcement processes."

Jordan  once Marissa completes the questionnaire draft, I'll review and add any legal/compliance notes before we send. Target: send to Alex by EOD today (Nov 5).

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
